name: Button — web3
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Button — web3.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Eyebrow
settings.how: Enter the eyebrow. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Headline
settings.how: Enter the headline. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Subheading
settings.how: Write the subheading. Keep paragraphs short and preview long text on mobile.

settings.label: Primary button label
settings.how: Enter the primary button label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Primary button link
settings.info: Link to your destination or wallet service. This theme does not establish a wallet connection.
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Secondary button label
settings.how: Enter the secondary button label. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Secondary button link
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Right-side illustration
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Background image (optional)
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Show wallet icons row
settings.how: Turn on “Show wallet icons row” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Preview connected appearance (editor only)
settings.how: Turn on “Preview connected appearance (editor only)” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Background style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for background style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Text alignment
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for text alignment. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Icon library
settings.info: Legacy Tabler filled/outline choices use the shared bundled symbol. Custom uploaded SVG assets retain their tint control.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for icon library. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Filename (no .svg)
settings.how: Enter the filename (no .svg). Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Custom relative path
settings.info: Filename of an uploaded theme asset, e.g. custom-logo.svg. For bundled icons use the library controls.
settings.how: Enter the custom relative path. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Icon color (tint)
settings.how: Choose a color for icon color (tint). Check the paired background or text color: body text needs readable contrast, including hover and focus states.

settings.label: Inline SVG (overrides file). use currentcolor in your SVG.
settings.how: Advanced: add trusted HTML. Keep headings, image alternatives, and links accessible. Use a duplicated unpublished theme for code changes.

settings.label: Alt text / name
settings.how: Enter the alt text / name. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.
